name: webhook-notify
description: Posts to Slack, Discord, Teams or ntfy when a long task finishes.

webhookUrl.title: Webhook URL
webhookUrl.description: Incoming webhook (Slack, Discord, Teams workflow), an ntfy topic URL, or any URL that accepts a JSON POST.

kind.title: Payload format
kind.description: auto picks the format from the URL; or force slack, discord, teams, ntfy or generic JSON.

minDurationSec.title: Minimum turn length (seconds)
minDurationSec.description: Only notify when a turn took at least this long.
